content_sections.heading: BBMB Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Note: The number of posts may vary to any extent depending upon exigency, either way (increase or decrease), including complete withdrawal. For horizontal reservation, candidates with disabilities under Category (B): Deaf and Hard of Hearing, and Category (C): Locomotor Disability (including Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims and Muscular Dystrophy) are considered on an equal-priority basis, with selection strictly on merit among these PwD categories. 1 seat out of the total 9 is reserved for PwD.

content_sections.heading: BBMB Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold one of the following academic qualifications: M.A. in English with Honours in Hindi; or M.A. in Hindi with Honours in English; or Law Graduate with Hindi Honours; or M.A. in Hindi with Honours; or M.A. in any subject along with M.A. in Hindi or Honours in Hindi; or M.A. in Hindi; or B.A./B.Sc. with Honours in Hindi. Along with the above, candidates need at least 3 years’ experience working as a Translator in any government, semi-government, or reputed daily newspaper organisation. Candidates with knowledge of proof reading and an inclination for literary work will be given preference. Requisite educational and experience certificates must be uploaded with the application form. The age limit for UR category candidates is between 18 and 37 years, reckoned as on 1 July 2026. Age relaxation applicable: PwD age relaxation applies for hearing impairment and locomotor disability/cerebral palsy in direct recruitment to identified posts, subject to a minimum of 40% disability and a maximum age of 56 years on the crucial date. Reservation and age relaxation benefits are available only to applicants holding the reservation certificate issued by the competent authority. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: BBMB Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Each applicant must pay a non-refundable online application fee of Rs. 1,000/- for UR/OBC/EWS category, and Rs. 500/- for Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. The fee must be deposited online by 23 September 2026, up to 11:59 PM.

content_sections.heading: BBMB Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: The post carries Pay Level-6 (Rs. 35,400-112,400) as per the 7th Central Pay Commission. Selected candidates will be appointed on a regular basis on a probation period of 3 years, on the initial of the pay scale as per Punjab C.S.R./as notified by BBMB, or the DC Rate as applicable, whichever is higher.

content_sections.heading: BBMB Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a Written Test of 100 marks and 90 minutes’ duration, covering: English Grammar, Hindi Grammar, General Awareness, Computer Proficiency, Translation from Hindi to English and English to Hindi, and Word Meaning (English to Hindi & Hindi to English). The question paper is MCQ-based, attempted on an OMR answer sheet, with 1 mark per question and no negative marking. Qualifying marks: 40% for UR/EWS category, 35% for Scheduled Tribe/OBC category (the committee may lower qualifying marks if suitable candidates are not found). A category-wise provisional merit list is prepared based on written test marks. Five times the number of vacancies in each category will be called for original document verification before the final merit list is prepared. In case of a tie, preference goes to the older candidate by date of birth; if the date of birth is also the same, marks obtained in Post Graduation decide the final order. A waiting list equal to 50% of advertised vacancies will be prepared and remains valid for 1 year. No TA/DA or any other expenses are paid for appearing in the test.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBMB Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register and fill the online application form through the BBMB recruitment web-link from 31 August 2026 onwards. Upload the requisite educational and experience certificates along with the application form. Fill in all columns of the form; write "N/A" where a column is not applicable. Pay the applicable non-refundable application fee online (Rs. 1,000/- for UR/OBC/EWS, Rs. 500/- for ST) by 23 September 2026. An applicant may submit only one application for the post. Departmental/serving Government employees should send a copy of their online application, along with qualification and experience certificates, through proper channel to the Member Secretary, Centralized Staff Selection Committee, BBMB, Plot No. 6B, Madhya Marg, Sector-19B, Chandigarh-160019, to reach on or before 21 September 2026 up to 1600 hours, and must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of the Written Test. Submit the completed application before the closing date of 21 September 2026, 11:59 PM. Applicants are advised not to wait until the last date, as BBMB is not responsible for submission failures due to last-minute server rush.

content_sections.heading: Other Important Points
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications, or those without signature, photograph, or requisite documents, are liable to be rejected. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere within the jurisdiction of BBMB. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. Possessing the minimum prescribed qualification does not by itself entitle an applicant to be called for the Written Test; the Committee may restrict candidates through a screening test or higher qualification/experience criteria if applications are numerous.
